hero.title: Buloqboshi Sanatorium
hero.subtitle: Your place for rest and recovery in the mountains

about.title: About Buloqboshi Sanatorium
about.description: Located at an altitude of 1,300 meters above sea level in the city of Parkent. We offer clean mountain air, professional doctors, and over 40 types of procedures.
about.sub_description: A unique place combining treatment and relaxation. Ideal for restoring the body and strengthening health in a calm mountain atmosphere.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Our sanatorium is an ideal place not only for improving your health, but also for active recreation and new adventures. Here you can do the following activities:

items.title: Treatment - Strengthening Health
items.desc: In our sanatorium, professional doctors offer more than 40 different procedures:
list: Physiotherapy – treatment of the body with physiotherapy equipment
Hydrotherapy – mineral baths and shower procedures
Massages – relaxation of muscles and joints
Ultrasound and diagnostics – timely detection and prevention of diseases
items.footer: If you want to get rid of a specific disease or fatigue, effective health programs await you in our sanatorium!

items.title: Relaxation - a quiet pastime among the mountains
items.desc: "Buloqboshi Sanatorium" is famous for its clean mountain air and offers guests a comfortable and relaxing holiday:
list: Walking in nature – relief from stress and a boost of energy
Relaxing on the trestle beds – enjoying the clean air and sun rays
Sauna and swimming pool – a great place for physical and mental relaxation
Billiards and table tennis – fun with friends
items.footer: If you dream of escaping from the noise and enjoying the silence, our sanatorium is the perfect place for this!

items.title: Nordic walking
items.desc: Nordic walking is a step towards health. An excellent choice for those who want to have an active rest in nature!
list: Increase physical activity and maintain a healthy lifestyle
Feeling of vigor and a surge of energy thanks to walks in the fresh air
Learning the correct walking technique from experienced instructors
items.footer: If you are looking for a healthy activity, do not miss this opportunity!

items.title: Marathons - physical activity and sport
items.desc: Marathons for sports enthusiasts are organized in "Buloqboshi Sanatorium":
list: Running on mountain trails – strengthening the body
Team sports marathons – active time with friends and new acquaintances
Discovery of new places and routes
items.footer: Do you love sports and want to direct your energy in the right direction? Join our marathons!

items.title: Pilgrimage and ECO tours - offering unforgettable moments
items.footer: Buloqboshi Sanatorium invites you to relax and find spiritual peace!

top_activities.title: Hijama and Leech Therapy
top_activities.desc: Hijama and leech therapy at "Buloqboshi Sanatorium" is a unique method of healing the body. This ancient therapy helps deeply cleanse blood vessels, restore energy balance, remove toxins, relax muscles, and improve blood circulation.
benefits: Effective fight against stress and fatigue

top_activities.title: Hydromassage
top_activities.desc: Hydromassage in "Buloqboshi Sanatorium" is one of the most effective procedures for relaxing the body, improving blood circulation and softening muscle tissue. Treatment is carried out using special water flows.
benefits: Relaxation of muscles and reduction of pain
Improvement of blood circulation and lymphatic system
Increased skin elasticity and cell renewal

top_activities.title: Cedar barrel
top_activities.desc: Cedar Barrel in Buloqboshi Sanatorium is a natural steam therapy for cleansing the body of toxins, strengthening the immune system and improving overall health. Mini-sauna made of natural cedar envelops the body in warm steam, stimulating the removal of harmful substances and accelerating metabolism.
benefits: Removal of toxins and harmful substances
Normalizing weight and rejuvenating the skin

services.massage_services_title: Massage services - for your health and well-being
services.massage_services_subtitle: "Buloqboshi Sanatorium" offers professional massage services to restore the body, relax muscles and improve overall well-being. Each treatment is carried out individually and is recommended depending on your health condition.

massage_services.title: Vacuum Cupping Massage
massage_services.desc: An effective procedure that helps improve blood circulation, relax muscles, and remove toxins using vacuum suction.

massage_services.title: Hydromassage
massage_services.desc: The effect on the skin and muscle tissue using special water streams reduces stress, improves blood circulation and relieves fatigue.

massage_services.title: Acupuncture
massage_services.desc: Impact on acupuncture points regulates the flow of energy in the body, improves the functioning of internal organs and reduces pain.

massage_services.title: Honey Massage
massage_services.desc: Massage using pure honey applied to the body deeply relaxes muscles, reduces inflammation, helps relieve stress, and provides a pleasant feeling of lightness.

massage_services.title: Classic massage
massage_services.desc: The most recommended type of massage to improve muscle tone, relieve fatigue and improve overall health.

massage_services.title: Manual therapy
massage_services.desc: Special techniques of manual manipulation of the spine and joints to improve mobility and reduce pain.
